target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, headless probe runner, HVF, virtio-ramfb, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-utm-qemu-probe-current.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps --probe-keepaway-full-game

checks.GrModels: Man mesh generation reached the repeat prompt; Ball mesh generation rendered an inline sprite with 723 purple pixels. Both returned to the graphical terminal.
checks.KeepAway: Court, HUD and player frame rendered; Space and mouse input were accepted; the full-game probe ran for 184 seconds with scanout changing through the observation; Escape returned to a working terminal where 40+2 returned 42; no Animate child remained.
checks.Titanium: Gameplay frame and input advanced; Escape returned to a terminal where 40+2 returned 42.
checks.runtime_status: The scoped 3D checks reported zstatus failed=0.
checks.follow_on_regressions: System server and launch queues, task settings, source contexts, home paths, source execution and exceptions, compiler recovery/contexts, graphical terminal keyboard editing/history, and window-demo launch/stop returned their expected checks. The process exited 0.

scope_note: This is a headless run using UTM's bundled QEMU framework and virtio-ramfb, not the user's live UTM window. It passes the reported KeepAway freeze interval in this setup but does not identify or resolve the live-window-specific failure. Pi hardware acceptance for the currently staged desktop image is also pending.
